The *Tikanikkhepa* (Ds 2.3.1) constitutes a major section of the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī*, the first book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. In this section, the text systematically expounds and classifies mental and material phenomena according to the twenty-two triads (*tika*) of the Abhidhamma matrix (*mātikā*) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records two translations in two modern languages [SuttaCentral].

SuttaCentral notes a curated passage-level parallel to the *Tikanikkhepa* in the *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 6, *Suttatthasamuccayabhūmi*), along with structurally resembling material in the *Mahāniddesa* (Mnd 2), the *Cullaniddesa* (Cnd 6, Cnd 23), and the immediately following section of the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī*, the *Dukanikkhepa* (Ds 2.3.2) [SuttaCentral]. It is also referenced or cross-cited in texts such as the *Khandha Saṁyutta* (SN 22.44 and its Chinese counterpart SA 69), the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* (Ps 1.2), and the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 20) [SuttaCentral].
